dedupe_keys.name: gb3d national bedrock fence diagram of great britain version 2014

description: The British Geological Survey provides GB3D as a national bedrock fence diagram for Great Britain and the Isle of Man. Version 2014 contains 246 intersecting geological sections exceeding 25,800 kilometres in total length and extending 1.5 to 6 kilometres below ground. Its 300 geological units complement the BGS 1:625,000 bedrock map. BGS lists 3D PDF, Shapefile, KMZ and specialist modelling formats, supplied free under the Open Government Licence version 3. The sections can inform regional groundwater, underground storage and transport-corridor simulations by providing geological context. Hydrogeological attributes are included for England and Wales. This update extends the 2012 version described in the journal article; the current BGS website also identifies UK3D version 2015 as a later successor. The sections simplify faults, minor intrusions and within-unit variations, so they cannot substitute for local investigations. Files were not downloaded and specialist viewer compatibility was not tested.
name: GB3D National Bedrock Fence Diagram of Great Britain, version 2014
notes: G3 G3-0197. Draft only. No resource files downloaded or software executed. Original 2012 deposit DOI: 10.5285/f60c6923-0bd2-4469-bc7a-9c0775453ac8.
